examples.arabic: الام كانت فرحانة عشان كله بياكل وبيتكلم
examples.english: The mother was happy because everyone is eating and talking
examples.transliteration: El om kaanet farhana ashaan kollo beyakol wa beyetkallem

examples.arabic: الأم حضرت الفطير المشلتت وطلبت قهوة زيادة لينا كلنا.
examples.english: The mother prepared the feteer meshaltet and asked for extra coffee for all of us.
examples.transliteration: El'omm haddaret elfeteer elmeshaltet watlabet 'ahwa ziyada leena kollena.

examples.arabic: يا حبيبي انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت واحنا في البيت دلوقتي ردت الام بتعب
examples.english: "My darling, I just drove the car to come home and we are at home now," the mother replied tiredly.
examples.transliteration: Ya habibi ana lessa say'a el arabeya ashan agi el bet we ehna fel bet delwa'ty raddet el omm be ta'ab
examples.storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

examples.arabic: الام بتقول اهلا وسهلا للكل وكله كويس الحمد لله
examples.english: The mother says "Welcome" to everyone and "Everything is good, praise be to God."
examples.transliteration: El-omm bet'ool ahlan wa sahlan lel-kol w kullo kwayyes alhamdulillah.

examples.arabic: الاب و الام قاعدين على السفرة
examples.english: The father and mother are sitting at the dining table.
examples.transliteration: El ab w el omm qa'dein 'ala el sofra.

examples.arabic: الام قالت السلام عليكم لما دخلت المطبخ
examples.english: The mother said "As-salamu alaykum" when she entered the kitchen.
examples.transliteration: El-omm 'alet As-salamu alaykum lamma dakhalet el-matbakh.
